question: Should per-agent dashboard grouping/collapse be accepted as bundled dashboard plugin work after Wave 1, and should whole-agent collapse state be transient UI state or persisted workspace preference?
rationale: The request is a new Control UI product surface layered on an unmerged dashboard architecture, so automation cannot choose the permanent storage, visibility, and roadmap boundary safely.

options.title: Stage After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 3 dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap Umbrella
options.body: Track this only through the Wave 2+ roadmap until maintainers sequence the larger dashboard program.

options.title: Defer Agent Grouping
options.body: Keep the initial dashboard model flat and revisit per-agent grouping only if real multi-agent usage proves the need.

recommendation.title: Stage After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 3 dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main routing signal for the bundled plugin-tab seam and Control UI product boundary this feature would extend.
